result.summary: The screen is mostly well-formed. The delivery address, search bar, category chips, promo banner, and cards are all aligned and readable. The main visible defect is in the 'Fastest near you' row, where the time badge on the first card overlaps the food image and looks misaligned. There are also a few minor contrast and consistency issues.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' row, the '15–25 min' badge on the Green Bowl Poké card sits lower and further left than the badges on the other cards. It overlaps the edge of the bowl image, so the badge placement looks inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Anchor all time badges with the same offset from the card's bottom-left corner and keep them clear of the image subject.

issues.description: Secondary text such as '€0.90 delivery', 'See all' links, the '(500+)' rating count, and the inactive tab labels (Search, Orders, Profile) is light gray or small. Contrast against the white background is low.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text and inactive icon colors to meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1).

issues.description: The heart/favorite buttons are styled inconsistently. The ramen card has a nearly invisible dark circle behind the heart, while the pizza card has a more visible translucent circle, so the icon's contrast varies with the image.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent button style, such as a semi-opaque white or dark circle with a fixed size, so the icon stays visible on any photo.

issues.description: The decorative circles on the green promo banner are clipped and overlap awkwardly at the bottom right. The white text on the mid-green gradient also has modest contrast.
issues.suggestion: Tidy the decorative shapes and darken the banner green slightly so the white text stays legible.
